items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The personnel of that movie was myself, Kid Ory, Buster Wilson, Montudie Garland, Barney Bigard and Ram Hall.

ctx.x: Tell us a bit about that movie, and I think there's something significant about it that relates to the blacklist that there was with the Red scare out in Hollywood, some years ago.
The actors in the picture were controversial and so was the story. The story was something pertaining to race also.
I saw the picture in one of the southside theaters and I think I saw it on T.V., a rerun of it.
